about.title: About LuminaTech
about.subtitle: Curating premium digital products for customers worldwide.
about.section1Body: LuminaTech was founded with a simple mission: make high-quality consumer electronics accessible to everyone, everywhere. We hand-pick every product in our catalog — from audio gear to smart wearables — ensuring each item meets our standards for design, performance, and value.
about.section2Body: Our store features carefully selected digital products across categories including audio, peripherals, storage, wearables, and accessories. Every product ships with official warranty coverage and is backed by our customer support team.
about.section3Body: We ship to customers in the United States, European Union, United Kingdom, and many other regions. All orders include tracking, and we work with trusted logistics partners to ensure safe, timely delivery.
about.section4Body: Your trust matters. We use industry-standard encryption for payments (Stripe and PayPal), never store your card details on our servers, and offer hassle-free returns within 30 days on unused items.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.subtitle: Last updated: August 2026. This policy explains how LuminaTech collects, uses, and protects your information.
privacy.section1Body: When you place an order, we collect your email address and payment information processed securely by Stripe or PayPal. We also collect browsing data (pages visited, device type) through standard server logs to improve our website.
privacy.section2Body: We use your email to send order confirmations and shipping updates. Payment data is used solely to process transactions. We do not sell your personal information to third parties.
privacy.section3Body: Our website uses essential cookies to maintain your shopping cart and language preference. We do not use third-party advertising cookies.
privacy.section4Body: All payment processing is handled by PCI-compliant providers (Stripe, PayPal). We implement industry-standard security measures to protect data stored on our servers.
privacy.section5Body: You may request access to, correction of, or deletion of your personal data by contacting us at support@luminatech.com. EU and UK residents have additional rights under GDPR.
privacy.section6Body: For privacy-related questions, email us at support@luminatech.com.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.subtitle: Last updated: August 2026. By using LuminaTech, you agree to these terms.
terms.section1Body: These Terms of Service govern your use of the LuminaTech website and purchase of products. By placing an order, you confirm that you are at least 18 years old and that the information you provide is accurate.
terms.section2Body: All prices are listed in USD unless otherwise stated. We reserve the right to correct pricing errors. Product images are for illustration; actual items may vary slightly. Stock availability is shown on each product page.
terms.section3Body: An order is confirmed once payment is successfully processed. We accept credit/debit cards via Stripe and PayPal. You will receive an email confirmation after purchase.
terms.section4Body: We ship to most countries worldwide. Delivery times vary by destination (typically 7–15 business days). Shipping costs and free-shipping thresholds are displayed at checkout.
terms.section5Body: Unused items in original packaging may be returned within 30 days of delivery. Contact support@luminatech.com to initiate a return. Refunds are processed within 5–10 business days after we receive the returned item.
terms.section6Body: LuminaTech is not liable for indirect or consequential damages arising from product use. Our liability is limited to the purchase price of the product in question.

contact.title: Contact Us
contact.subtitle: We're here to help. Reach out and we'll get back to you within 1–2 business days.
contact.section1Body: For order inquiries, returns, product questions, or technical support, email us at the address below. Please include your order number if applicable.
contact.section2Body: For wholesale, partnership, or press inquiries, please use the same contact email with your company details and we will route your message to the appropriate team.
